messages:
mira: hey team — noticed a brief spike in 502/504s around the deploy window at ~22:45 UTC. Can someone point me to the best per-route error histograms and a quick way to grab sample traces? Trying to confirm if this is a proxy timeout vs upstream overload.

jonah: quick pointers — use the 'infra/request-errors-by-route' dashboard for histograms, and 'obs/edge-timeouts' for gateway-specific timeouts.

jonah: prom query I usually run to get per-route 5xx rate (5m):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route)
```

sam-ops: if you want raw traces filter span.name=\"http.server\" and search for status_code>=500 in our trace UI. Dashboard links: https://dash.redwood/internal/infra/request-errors-by-route and https://dash.redwood/internal/obs/edge-timeouts

mira: thanks — any quick curl example to fetch a sample request-id from logs/edge to feed into the trace search?

devex: yep — grab a recent request id from the logs query, or hit the proxy with the same header to reproduce. Example (grep from log stream):
```
# tail the last 400 lines of the ingress logs and grep 502
kubectl logs -n prod svc/proxy -c proxy --tail=400 | grep \" 502 \" | head -n 5
# extract request-id header from the line
```

devex: if you have a request-id you can do: 
```
# open trace by request id (trace ui quick link)
https://traces.redwood/trace/{{REQUEST_ID}}
```

sre-bot: alert: PROD_GATEWAY_5XX spike triggered at 2245609952 - see runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/prod-gateway-5xx 

mira: can we temp-snooze noisy route-level alerts while we verify? It looks like a short redeploy blip. Suggest 15m quiet on route-level 5xx (not global SLO).

jonah: I can pause the route-level alert for 15m. @sam-ops please confirm you don't need full alert suppression.

sam-ops: +1 to 15m. I can monitor the ingresses and roll it back if it continues. :thumbsup:

mira: also, quick checklist I ran: check prefix/KV cache misses (kvcache-misses dashboard), check backend queue depth and connection resets. If you see a lot of `kvcache timeout` or `connection reset by peer` that points to upstream overload.

jonah: for correlation, look at these two panels side-by-side: 1) request-errors-by-route (histogram) 2) pool/worker-queue-depth (time series). If queue depth spikes align with 5xx bursts -> overload.

devex: FYI — if you need to run a short canary rollback, the deploy-bot can trigger a canary revert: `/deploy revert canary svc/api 2245609000` (internal).

mira: thanks all — I'll capture a few request-ids and paste them here once I have samples. If anyone sees sustained 5xx after the pause, ping @oncall immediately.

jonah: also filing a tiny follow-up: we should consider a 2x debounce window for the route-level alert when the deploy pipeline is active (proposal in infra-ops backlog).

sam-ops: noted — I'll add a short PR to infra-alerting with that param.

mira: 👍 closing for now, will reopen if I find persistent traces.
